name: The Exorcism
statusNote: Unchanged in Forever as far as is known: the text, objectives and rewards below are Classic’s.
footerSourceNote: Text, givers, objectives and rewards come from the cMaNGOS Classic database (a reconstruction of the 1.12 world), with what Forever changed on top: the game server’s own answers where we have them, else Wowhead’s Forever database. narrative.details:
Now that we have a summoner's orb, we must exorcise the demon within it.  I can do that.  That's the easy part.

You're the one who has the hard job.  You're the one who has to kill the demon once it's out.

And you'll have to be quick.  If you take too long then he'll jump back in the orb and we'll have to start over!

So get yourself ready.  Prepare your strongest spells and keep your potions handy, and go get a friend if you have one.  Because this isn't going to be pretty.
narrative.objectives: Kill the Demon of the Orb, then speak with Tabetha.
narrative.offerRewardText:
Nicely done, adventurer! You gave that demon a lesson he won't soon forget.

He'll think twice before he sticks his ugly head back in this world, looking for the stupid mortal who beat him. Probably with friends this time. Big, scaly friends who'd want nothing more than to tear you into little friend pieces.

I didn't scare you, did I...adventurer?
narrative.requestItemsText: You'll have to kill that demon to remove its taint from the orb, adventurer.
